DYFG.description: Railway Dynamic Factor (DYFG). A single global setting (key is always 1) whose fields configure how the dynamic amplification factor for railway moving loads is determined and maintained.

INPUT_TYPE.description: Input type integer code controlling how the dynamic factor is obtained. 0 = program auto-computes the factor; 1 = user directly supplies DYN_FACTOR.

LENGTH.description: Determinant length Lphi used in the dynamic factor formula.

MAINTAIN_TYPE.description: Quality of track maintenance integer code. 0 = carefully maintained track; 1 = standard maintenance.

OPT_REDUCE_EFF.description: Whether to consider the reduced dynamic effect (e.g. for buried structures where cover reduces the dynamic amplification). When true, HEIGHT_COVER is used.

HEIGHT_COVER.description: Height of cover h above the structure, used when computing the reduced dynamic effect.

DYN_FACTOR.description: Dynamic factor phi. Used as the applied factor when INPUT_TYPE = 1 (user input).
